description: Extension methods for registering the Tempo.Blazor AI component group.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorAI
members.description: Registers the services required by the AI conversation components. Also calls AddTempoBlazor(). The AI model and streaming contracts live in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions (Tempo.Blazor.AI.Models / .Services), so no LLM SDK is pulled in; the only third-party dependency is Markdig, behind AiMarkdownRenderer.
